# Vision Apps

> Umbrella repository for Paul Kirby's accessibility toolkit.

- [ChromaCalm](https://github.com/markkirby125/chromacalm): Zero-install spectral notch filtering web tool for photophobia, migraine, and screen halation.
- [SoftContrast](https://github.com/markkirby125/softcontrast): Anti-halation reading palette generator using APCA and OKLCH.
- [terminal-a11y](https://github.com/markkirby125/terminal-a11y): Terminal accessibility enhancement layer (screen-reader, photophobia, sensory-budget, braille, audio-progress).
- [FocusBeacon](https://github.com/markkirby125/focusbeacon): Ultra-lightweight vanilla JS focus-ring accessibility engine with a high-contrast dual-contour focus ring and cursor radar.

In planning / in build (see `docs/TASKS.md` → Phased Implementation Plans):
- [GlareMap](https://github.com/markkirby125/glaremap): Spatial glare heatmap + targeted softening (hybrid lab + bookmarklet). Build approved 2026-09-11 — in progress. Plan: `planning/glaremap/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`.
- TemporalSafe: Page-level flicker/flash reducer (userscript + demo page). Planning only. Plan: `planning/temporalsafe/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`.
- Keratoscope: Astigmatism ghosting calibration lab (userstyle export). Planning only. Plan: `planning/keratoscope/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`.
